profile.headline: IBMi Developer at IBM
profile.summary: Professional software developer with a proven history of successful work experiences including data communications, storage solutions, hardware drivers and interfaces, training (server, storage allocation training), application development, test automation, tool scripting and lab build-outs. I continue to build upon my technical background to not only meet customer requirements but to deliver the best customer experience possible. I am able to resolve complex storage, networking infrastructure and software issues of all types, including virtualization environments within the cloud.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer/Networking Team Lead
positions.description:
● Member of IBMi Network Applications development department which is responsible for networking services and utilities, SSL/TLS security APIs and kernel sockets interfaces. Responsibilities include customer defect triage, component design, code maintenance and quality reviews for networking protocols and IBMi user interfaces.
● Designed and deployed a networking protocol stress testing framework utilizing a combination of expect, Bash, Python and C development environments. 
● Member of AIX kernel development team responsible for networking middleware. Responsibilities include customer defect triage, component design, code maintenance and quality reviews for networking sockets and TCP/IP protocols.
● Responsible for installation and support of AIX Logical and Workload partitions to enable defect verification and software unit testing.
● Maintained and expanded the AIX RDMA protocol stack utilizing the OFED Open Source technologies to meet customer customer requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
● Member of Enterprise Storage Product test team. Responsible for the execution of complex test-cases related to Dell NAS products. Other duties include product defect triage, test tool development and test lab infrastructure build-out. 
● Responsible for automated test procedure design and deployment using Python and Expect technologies for DELL backup appliance products.

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
● Build lead role for both multiple software products. This role incorporates a great deal of scripting and application integration knowledge with the details of fully automated software building environment. This environment includes multiple compilers and software tool sets on the most common Unix and Windows platforms. Additional responsibilities included configuring and maintaining a group of server systems which conform to IBM security standards.
● Developed and deployed a C# .net Web console application to allow build users greater visibility and ease of use for the automated build infrastructure. 
● Responsible for common utility support and maintenance for the product development teams. This includes Rational Build-forge components and CMVC source control.
● Previously held a test support position within financial software services group. Responsibilities included test scenario planning, test tool development and test plan execution. 
● Designed and development automated test tool solutions utilizing the IBM STAF framework. This included extensive script work on multi-platform topologies which included Windows, and Unix servers in a multi-interface networking environment.
● Ownership of test quality control records. This included defect origination and problem analysis for financial software components.
● Primary contact for OS instillations and hardware upgrades dealing with lab machines associated with the automated testing framework. This includes work with virtual solutions on x86 and power systems. For both Unix and windows operating systems.

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
• Responsible for the design, implementation and debugging of various user-level software components that are part of a large scale message transaction solution for financial service companies. This effort also included customized  system test applications,  simulators and message generators for standard stock exchange feed protocols. Another complementary project was a C code compatibility library supporting various system functions for Linux, Solaris and Windows platforms. 
• Developed a scalable test harness in C and X-windows for Linux systems that measured performance data for high-speed message passing appliances.
• Created a user-level Infiniband library for use on Sun Solaris platforms (SPARC and x86) in conjunction with the existing DAPL kernel drivers. The library API was designed as a subset of the Open Fabrics (OFED) verbs transport and RDMA CMA interfaces.

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
● Responsible for problem screening, failure information analysis and fix coordination between IBM system test groups and Linux Kernel development teams.
● Developed and maintained custom GNU build environments (make-files, startup scripts etc) that linked application level service processor firmware with the IBM embedded Linux system.

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Jan 1984
